spine.zh: 标普五连跌与金价新低

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (19 November). Wednesday closes, the Fed minutes, COMEX gold, LME copper, Tencent's quarter, and bitcoin near 6.23 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月19日）。周三收盘、美联储纪要、COMEX黄金、LME铜、腾讯季报，以及比特币约6.23万美元。

influence.en: Yicai (19 November). The same Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq closes, December WTI at 83.26 dollars, and the November COMEX gold contract at 3736.80 dollars.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月19日）。同一组道指、标普500和纳斯达克收盘，12月WTI报83.26美元，11月COMEX黄金报3736.80美元。

influence.en: US Treasury curve for 18 November. The 2-year yield is 4.80%, the 10-year is 5.07%, and the 30-year is 5.41%. On 17 November they were 4.80%, 5.10%, and 5.46%.
Caixin (18 November). Nvidia will stop shipping licensed Hopper data-center products to China. That line brought in 2.4 billion dollars in the third quarter.
influence.zh: 财新（11月18日）。英伟达将停止向中国出货特许Hopper数据中心产品。该产品第三季度收入24亿美元。

influence.en: 19 November 财经早茶. A wider hike consensus, Anthropic's 83 dollar price, Tencent's AI spending, and the Shenzhen meetings.
influence.zh: 11月19日财经早茶。加息共识增强、Anthropic定价83美元、腾讯的人工智能支出，以及深圳的会晤。

influence.en: BlockBeats (19 November). Almost all officials thought further increases could be appropriate, and Waller raised a 50 basis point step in December.
influence.zh: 律动（11月19日）。几乎所有官员认为进一步加息可能是适宜的，沃勒提出12月加息50个基点。

influence.en: CICC (15 November). A 25 basis point December increase was already in the price, and a 50 basis point step was not. A warning of that larger step would support the dollar.
influence.zh: 中金（11月15日）。12月加息25个基点已经计入价格，50个基点还没有。若纪要警告需要更大幅度，美元会得到支撑。

influence.en: Glassnode (17 November). Realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月17日）。已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。

title.en: More of China's goods surplus is received at home
title.zh: 中国货物顺差里，更多已经收回到境内

analysis.en: The 12-month average of net goods-trade receipts as a share of the customs surplus has risen from about 40 percent in 2024 to about 80 percent at the right-hand edge. The monthly ratio still swings widely. A higher share means more of the surplus is arriving as cash at home, which can support the yuan and domestic deposits.
analysis.zh: 十二条移动平均显示，货物贸易净收款占海关顺差的比重，从2024年大约四成升到图右端大约八成。月度比值仍大幅跳动。比重升高，说明更多顺差已经变成境内实际收到的货款，可以支撑人民币和境内存款。

marketTone.en: US stocks split, and the S&P 500 fell for a fifth day. The Fed's October minutes showed a wider hike consensus, and gold and crude prices fell.
marketTone.zh: 美股涨跌分化，标普500连续第五日下跌。美联储10月会议纪要显示加息共识更广，黄金和原油下跌。

text.en: The Dow fell 1.11% to 50198.17, the S&P 500 fell 0.23% to 7323.63, a fifth straight drop, and the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24429.88, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：道指下跌1.11%至50198.17，标普500下跌0.23%至7323.63，为连续第五日下跌，纳斯达克上涨0.42%至24429.88。

text.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.80%, the 10-year is 5.07%, and the 30-year is 5.41%. On 17 November they were 4.80%, 5.10%, and 5.46%.

December WTI fell 3.20% to 83.26 dollars and January Brent fell 1.28% to 91.95 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot Brent row is the Yahoo BZ=F quote, a different quote from this January price.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌3.20%至83.26美元，1月布伦特下跌1.28%至91.95美元。行情快照的布伦特一行是Yahoo的BZ=F报价，和这一1月价格不是同一报价。

text.en: COMEX December gold fell 3.52% to 3728.20 dollars an ounce, 华尔街见闻 reported. 第一财经 reported the November contract fell 3.16% to 3736.80 dollars. The Market snapshot gold row is the Yahoo futures quote, a different quote from these COMEX prices.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金下跌3.52%至每盎司3728.20美元。第一财经：11月合约下跌3.16%至3736.80美元。行情快照的黄金一行是Yahoo期货报价，和这两个COMEX价格不是同一报价。

text.en: Shanghai rose 0.09% to 3587.83, Shenzhen rose 0.20% to 10659.41, and the ChiNext index rose 0.85% to 2311.62. Turnover was 1.37 trillion yuan, a low for the year, and more than 4100 stocks fell. The Hang Seng fell 0.91% to 23294.75, and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 0.58% to 3736.33, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证上涨0.09%至3587.83，深证成指上涨0.20%至10659.41，创业板指上涨0.85%至2311.62。沪深成交1.37万亿元，创年内新低，逾4100只个股下跌。恒生指数下跌0.91%至23294.75，恒生科技指数下跌0.58%至3736.33。

text.en: The Nikkei 225 rose 0.28% to 59024.28, and the Kospi rose 1.99% to 5067.44, 华尔街见闻 reported. Those are the completed Wednesday closes.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：日经225上涨0.28%至59024.28，韩国综指上涨1.99%至5067.44。这是周三已经完成的收盘。

text.en: The dollar index rose 0.36% to 103.862, the highest since April 2025. Onshore yuan closed at 6.6653 at 16:30, 2 pips stronger than the previous session, and offshore yuan was at 6.6693, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot USD/CNY row is the Yahoo quote, a different quote from these 16:30 prints.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：美元指数上涨0.36%至103.862，为2025年4月以来最高。在岸人民币16:30收于6.6653，较上一交易日升值2个基点，离岸人民币报6.6693。行情快照的美元兑人民币一行是Yahoo报价，和这两个16:30价格不是同一报价。

text.en: Bitcoin was about 6.23 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale and down about 3.9% on the day, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Market snapshot bitcoin row is the CoinGecko quote, a different quote from this one.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币约6.23万美元，日内跌约3.9%。行情快照的比特币一行是CoinGecko报价，和这一报价不是同一报价。

text.en: LME three-month copper fell 5.7% to 12471 dollars a tonne, the lowest close since early April, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜下跌5.7%至每吨12471美元，为4月初以来最低收盘。

signal.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.23% to 7323.63, a fifth straight drop, and the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24429.88. The 10-year Treasury yield is 5.07%, down from 5.10% on 17 November. December WTI fell 3.20% to 83.26 dollars, and COMEX December gold fell 3.52% to 3728.20 dollars.
signal.zh: 标普500下跌0.23%至7323.63，连续第五日下跌，纳斯达克上涨0.42%至24429.88。10年期国债收益率报5.07%，11月17日为5.10%。12月WTI下跌3.20%至83.26美元。COMEX 12月黄金下跌3.52%至3728.20美元。

watch.en: Xi meets Trump at 12:45 Beijing. The China-US-Russia summit is at 14:30. Anthropic lists on the Nasdaq at 21:30. US jobless claims and the Philadelphia Fed index are at 21:30. ECB president Lagarde speaks at 21:30.
watch.zh: 习近平与特朗普的会晤在北京时间12:45。中美俄峰会在14:30。Anthropic在21:30于纳斯达克挂牌。美国申请失业救济人数和费城联储指数在21:30。欧洲央行行长拉加德在21:30讲话。

title.en: The minutes widened the hike consensus, and long-term yields still fell
title.zh: 纪要扩大了加息共识，长端收益率仍然回落

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.80%, the 10-year is 5.07%, and the 30-year is 5.41%. On 17 November they were 4.80%, 5.10%, and 5.46%. 华尔街见闻 reported that almost all participants thought a further increase could be appropriate, and that two participants said a move of more than 25 basis points could be considered if the inflation data are poor.
fact.zh: 美国财政部：2年期收益率4.80%，10年期5.07%，30年期5.41%。11月17日分别为4.80%、5.10%和5.46%。华尔街见闻：几乎所有与会者认为进一步加息可能是适宜的，两名与会者表示，若通胀数据不佳，可以考虑一次超过25个基点的加息。

mechanism.en: Long-term yields fell on a day when the minutes widened the hike consensus, so the extra tightening showed up in the dollar. CICC (15 November): a 25 basis point December increase was already in the price and a 50 basis point step was not, and a warning of that larger step would support the dollar. The dollar is where that larger step would show, while the 10-year yield fell to 5.07%.
mechanism.zh: 纪要扩大了加息共识的这一天，长端收益率回落了，多出来的紧缩体现在美元上。中金（11月15日）：12月加息25个基点已经在价格里，50个基点还不在，若有人警告需要更大幅度，美元会得到支撑。更大幅度会先体现在美元上，而10年期收益率回落到了5.07%。

title.en: The S&P 500 fell for a fifth day, and Nvidia gave back the earnings jump
title.zh: 标普500五连跌，英伟达吐回了财报跳涨

fact.en: The S&P 500 fell 0.23% to 7323.63, a fifth straight drop. The Dow fell 1.11% to 50198.17, and the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24429.88. Nvidia fell 2.96%, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index rose 0.10%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：标普500下跌0.23%至7323.63，连续第五日下跌。道指下跌1.11%至50198.17，纳斯达克上涨0.42%至24429.88。英伟达下跌2.96%，费城半导体指数上涨0.10%。

mechanism.en: The cash session fell for a fifth day, and Nvidia gave back the earnings jump. 财经早茶 (19 November): Moody's cut the outlook to stable, and the company told staff that Huang will not return. US stocks are carrying that leadership question, and the Nasdaq still closed higher.
mechanism.zh: 常规交易时段连续第五日下跌，英伟达把财报跳涨吐了回去。财经早茶（11月19日）：穆迪把评级展望下调至稳定，公司向员工明确黄仁勋不会回归。美股在消化这个领导层问题，纳斯达克仍然收涨。

title.en: Gold fell to its lowest since September 2025 as the hike consensus widened
title.zh: 加息共识扩大，黄金跌至2025年9月以来最低

fact.en: COMEX December gold fell 3.52% to 3728.20 dollars an ounce, and spot gold fell 3.23% to 3724.89 dollars, the lowest since 26 September 2025, 华尔街见闻 reported. Goldman Sachs cut its gold target to 4650 dollars, a second cut in 11 days, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金下跌3.52%至每盎司3728.20美元，现货黄金下跌3.23%至3724.89美元，为2025年9月26日以来最低。高盛把黄金目标价下调至4650美元，11天内第二次下调。

mechanism.en: Gold fell to its lowest since September 2025 on the same day the hike consensus widened. GS (18 November): the bank cut its gold target to 4650 dollars for the second time in 11 days, because hike expectations are weighing on Western ETF demand. Gold is falling with that higher-rate outlook.
mechanism.zh: 加息共识扩大的同一天，黄金跌到2025年9月以来的最低。高盛（11月18日）：该行11天内第二次把黄金目标价下调至4650美元，因为加息预期压着西方ETF的需求。黄金跟着这个更高利率的前景下跌。

title.en: Crude fell on profit-taking and hike expectations
title.zh: 获利了结和加息预期之下，原油下跌

fact.en: December WTI fell 3.20% to 83.26 dollars a barrel, and January Brent fell 1.28% to 91.95 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported. It was the first WTI close under 85 dollars since the end of August, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：12月WTI下跌3.20%至每桶83.26美元，1月布伦特下跌1.28%至91.95美元。这是8月底以来WTI首次收在85美元下方。

mechanism.en: Crude fell while clashes around the Gulf continued, and the morning note pointed to profit-taking and hike expectations. 财经早茶 (19 November): traders took profits and moved toward haven assets as those hike expectations rose. Oil prices fell with that shift, and December WTI closed at 83.26 dollars.
mechanism.zh: 海湾一带仍有交火，原油却下跌了，早报指向的是获利了结和加息预期。财经早茶（11月19日）：交易员获利了结，并因加息预期转向避险资产。油价跟着这个转变下跌，12月WTI收在83.26美元。

title.en: London copper fell to its lowest close since early April
title.zh: 伦铜跌至4月初以来最低收盘

fact.en: LME three-month copper fell 5.7% to 12471 dollars a tonne, the lowest close since early April, 华尔街见闻 reported. Zinc fell 5.2% and tin fell 5.0%, and aluminum and nickel fell as well, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜下跌5.7%至每吨12471美元，为4月初以来最低收盘。锌下跌5.2%，锡下跌5.0%，铝和镍也下跌。

mechanism.en: London industrial metals fell together, and the copper drop lined up with weaker expectations for AI infrastructure spending. 财经早茶 (19 November): Stan Druckenmiller, a well-known bull of copper tied to that spending, turned bearish as that demand case cooled. Copper and the other London metals fell with that cooler demand case.
mechanism.zh: 伦敦工业金属一起下跌，铜的跌幅和人工智能基础设施开支预期转弱对得上。财经早茶（11月19日）：和这笔开支绑在一起的知名铜多头Stan Druckenmiller转为空头，因为这套需求判断凉了下来。铜和旁边的伦敦金属跟着这套更凉的需求判断下跌。

title.en: Anthropic priced the IPO at 83 dollars, above the earlier range
title.zh: Anthropic把IPO定价在83美元，高于此前区间

fact.en: Anthropic priced its IPO at 83 dollars a share under the ticker ANT, for a Nasdaq listing on 19 November, 华尔街见闻 reported. Institutional orders were about 400 billion dollars and retail orders were near 100 billion dollars, and the valuation could exceed 1.5 trillion dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：Anthropic把IPO定价在每股83美元，代码ANT，11月19日在纳斯达克挂牌。机构认购约4000亿美元，散户认购接近1000亿美元，估值有望超过1.5万亿美元。

mechanism.en: The price was set above the range discussed earlier, and the order book is already closed, so the first session tests whether demand for AI shares is still there after five down days. 财经早茶 (19 November): Thursday's listing will show whether the AI trade still has demand. US stocks are the market this listing can move, and the shares have not opened yet.
mechanism.zh: 定价高于此前讨论的区间，订单簿已经关上，所以第一个交易日要看五连跌之后，人工智能股票的需求还在不在。财经早茶（11月19日）：周四的上市会看出人工智能交易还有没有需求。美股是这场上市能够带动的市场，股票还没有开盘。

title.en: Nvidia will stop shipping licensed Hopper chips to China
title.zh: 英伟达将停止向中国出货特许Hopper芯片

fact.en: Caixin reported that Nvidia will no longer ship licensed Hopper data-center products to China, and that those products brought in 2.4 billion dollars, about 16 billion yuan, in the third quarter. 财经早茶 reported that Citigroup and JPMorgan added export-control clauses to a loan for Bridge Data Centres.
fact.zh: 财新：英伟达将不再向中国出货特许Hopper数据中心产品，该产品第三季度收入24亿美元，约合160亿元。财经早茶：花旗和摩根大通在Bridge Data Centres的一笔贷款文件中加入了出口管制合规条款。

mechanism.en: Stopping Hopper shipments takes that China revenue out of later guidance, and lenders are writing the same limit into data-center loans. Caixin (18 November): the interim chief said later guidance includes none of that China revenue. Chip suppliers and the China technology firms that need those chips are the markets that move.
mechanism.zh: 停止出货Hopper，等于把这部分中国收入从后续指引里拿掉，贷款行也在把同一条限制写进数据中心贷款。财新（11月18日）：临时首席说，后续指引不再包含这部分中国收入。芯片供应商，以及需要这些芯片的中国科技公司，是会跟着动的市场。

title.en: Tencent's AI spending squeezed profit while revenue still grew
title.zh: 腾讯营收仍在增长，人工智能开支压住了利润

fact.en: Tencent's third-quarter revenue rose 8% and came in below the estimate, non-IFRS operating profit fell 6%, and capital spending far exceeded the estimate, with free cash flow negative again, 华尔街见闻 reported. Cloud revenue growth rose to 35%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：腾讯第三季度营收同比增长8%，低于预期，非国际财务报告准则经营盈利同比下降6%，资本开支远超预期，自由现金流再次为负。云业务收入增速升至35%。

mechanism.en: Revenue still grew, and the miss is the spending: capital expenditure ran well above the estimate, and free cash flow stayed negative. 财经早茶 (19 November): president Liu said US limits on advanced chips in overseas data centers will slow Chinese model development in the near term and speed domestic chips later. Tencent shares and the Hang Seng Tech index are the markets carrying that spending and that limit.
mechanism.zh: 营收还在增长，失手的是开支：资本开支远高于预期，自由现金流仍是负的。财经早茶（11月19日）：总裁刘炽平说，美国限制中国企业使用海外数据中心的先进芯片，短期内会拖慢中国模型开发，长期会推动国产芯片。腾讯股价和恒生科技指数，是在承担这笔开支和这条限制的市场。

title.en: Bitcoin fell about 3.9% as hike expectations rose
title.zh: 加息预期上升，比特币日内跌约3.9%

fact.en: Bitcoin was about 6.23 on the ten-thousand-dollar scale and down about 3.9% on the day, and Strategy fell 5.9%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币约6.23万美元，日内跌约3.9%，Strategy下跌5.9%。

mechanism.en: Bitcoin fell on a day when hike expectations rose, and Strategy shares fell with it. Glassnode (17 November): realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows. Bitcoin, which pays no yield, feels the higher-rate outlook first.
mechanism.zh: 加息预期上升的这一天，比特币下跌，Strategy的股价一起跌。Glassnode（11月17日）：已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。比特币不产生利息，会先感受到这个更高利率的前景。

title.en: UK inflation hit a near one-year high, and December hike odds fell
title.zh: 英国通胀升至近一年高位，12月加息概率下降

fact.en: UK October CPI rose 3.6% from a year earlier, up from 3.5% in September and the highest in nearly a year, matching the forecast, 华尔街见闻 reported. Services inflation stayed at 3.7%, below the 3.8% forecast, core inflation was unchanged at 2.8%, and the priced chance of a December Bank of England increase fell from about 90% to about 80%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：英国10月CPI同比上涨3.6%，高于9月的3.5%，为近一年最高，与预期一致。服务业通胀维持在3.7%，低于3.8%的预期，核心通胀持平于2.8%，交易员对英国央行12月加息25个基点的押注从约90%降至约80%。

mechanism.en: A higher headline with a softer services reading pulled the odds of a December Bank of England increase down, and sterling fell with that. 财经早茶 (19 November): the pound fell to a near one-year low after the inflation figures. Sterling and short-dated UK rates are the markets that moved.
mechanism.zh: 整体读数更高，服务业读数更软，英国央行12月加息的概率被拉低了，英镑跟着下跌。财经早茶（11月19日）：通胀数据公布后，英镑跌至近一年低点。英镑和英国短端利率是跟着动的市场。

text.en: The S&P 500 fell for a fifth day. Anthropic's listing is the test of the AI trade.
text.zh: 标普500指数录得五连跌，Anthropic重磅上市将成AI交易试金石。

text.en: The Golden Dragon index fell for a third day. Alibaba and JD were the biggest drags.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数三连跌，阿里巴巴和京东对指数拖累最大。

text.en: Treasuries rose. Solid demand at the 20-year auction supported the long end.
text.zh: 国债上涨，20年期国债招标需求稳健支撑长端。

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index set another high, the strongest in more than 18 months. The pound fell to a near one-year low after the inflation data.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数续创逾18个月新高，英镑在通胀数据公布后跌至近一年低点。

text.en: European bonds recovered intraday losses as oil prices fell. European stocks fell for a third day, and the copper drop weighed on mining shares.
text.zh: 随着油价下跌，欧洲债券收复盘中失地。欧洲股市连续第三日走低，铜价暴跌拖累矿业股。

text.en: Crude futures fell. Traders took profits and shifted toward haven assets as Fed hike expectations rose.
text.zh: 原油期货下跌，交易员获利了结，并因美联储加息预期而转向避险资产。

text.en: Gold fell to a one-year low as the Fed hike consensus strengthened. A cooler case for AI demand hit London copper hard.
text.zh: 美联储加息共识增强之际，金价跌至一年低点。AI需求叙事降温拖累伦敦期铜重挫。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks split, and the S&P 500 fell for a fifth day, while the Fed's October minutes showed that almost all participants thought further increases could be appropriate. Gold and crude prices fell. Shanghai edged higher on the thinnest turnover of the year.
globalRegime.zh: 美股涨跌分化，标普500五连跌。美联储10月会议纪要显示，几乎所有与会者认为进一步加息可能是适宜的。黄金和原油下跌。上证小幅收涨，成交是年内最淡的一天。

text.en: The leaders of China, the US, and Russia will hold a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday. The war in Ukraine, the Iran conflict, and arms control are expected to be discussed. Trump and Putin are also reported to meet bilaterally that day, and the Kremlin said it wants a substantive discussion, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中美俄元首周四将在深圳举行三方峰会，俄乌战争、伊朗冲突和军控料成讨论焦点。特朗普与普京据悉当天也将举行双边会晤，克里姆林宫称希望进行实质性讨论。

text.en: The Fed's October minutes show that almost all participants thought further increases may be needed in the coming months so inflation can return to 2% in good time. Views on the pace differ. Governor Waller suggested a 50 basis point increase in December, and the San Francisco Fed president called for a careful tightening, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美联储10月会议纪要显示，几乎所有与会官员都认为未来几个月可能需要加息，以推动通胀及时回落至2%的目标。决策者对加息步伐看法不一。理事沃勒建议12月加息50个基点，旧金山联储行长呼吁审慎推进政策收紧。

text.en: Trump administration officials said Iranian cyber attacks have targeted US critical infrastructure, and that recent technical failures and the nationwide grounding of flights are unrelated, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普政府官员称，伊朗网络攻击一直将美国关键基础设施作为目标，但近期技术故障以及全美航班停飞与此无关。

text.en: ECB president Lagarde said AI share valuations are very aggressive and that a correction could come. She also said she may consider leading the World Economic Forum after she leaves the ECB, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：欧洲央行行长拉加德称，人工智能股票估值非常激进，最终可能出现调整。她还表示，卸任后可能考虑出任世界经济论坛领导职务。

text.en: The Minneapolis Fed president said the scale of AI investment creates a concentration risk for the US economy, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：明尼阿波利斯联储行长表示，人工智能领域规模庞大的投资给美国经济带来集中度风险。

text.en: Anthropic is reported to have set its IPO price at 83 dollars a share. The company is expected to list on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Anthropic据悉将IPO发行价定在每股83美元，预计周四在纳斯达克上市，股票代码为ANT。

text.en: Nvidia sent a steadying message to staff and made clear that Huang will not return. Moody's cut the rating outlook from positive to stable, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英伟达向员工传递稳定信号，明确黄仁勋不会回归。穆迪将信用评级展望从正面下调至稳定。

text.en: Democratic members of the US House asked Cantor Fitzgerald, the firm Lutnick used to run, for its Nvidia holdings and related business records, to examine whether the commerce secretary's decision to allow Nvidia chip exports to Megaspeed involved a conflict of interest, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国民主党众议员要求卢特尼克此前掌管的Cantor Fitzgerald提交英伟达持仓及相关商业资料，以调查这位商务部长允许英伟达向Megaspeed出口芯片的决定是否涉及利益冲突。

text.en: Citigroup and JPMorgan added export-control compliance clauses to loan documents for Bain Capital's Bridge Data Centres, on a facility that could be increased to 6.6 billion dollars. The clauses put compliance on the borrower, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：花旗和摩根大通在贝恩资本旗下Bridge Data Centres寻求的一笔潜在增额至66亿美元的贷款文件中加入出口管制合规条款，明确由借款人负责遵守芯片获取限制。

text.en: Some investors are treating Apple as a haven while AI shares swing. The shares are up more than 29% this year, but a forward price-earnings ratio of 37 is the highest since 2007, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：人工智能板块动荡之际，部分投资者把苹果视为避险港。股价今年以来上涨逾29%，但37倍预期市盈率已升至2007年以来最高。

text.en: As expectations for AI infrastructure spending cooled, London copper plunged 5.7% overnight, and Stan Druckenmiller, a well-known bull of that copper trade, turned bearish, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：人工智能需求预期降温，伦敦期铜隔夜重挫5.7%。这套铜交易最知名的看多者之一Stan Druckenmiller转为空头。

text.en: Iran struck US military sites in Kuwait and Bahrain, and US forces struck a missile site on Qeshm. 华尔街见闻 described it as the third exchange of fire in five days.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：伊朗袭击科威特和巴林境内的美军设施，美军空袭格什姆岛导弹发射场，为5天内第三次交火。

text.en: Reuters, cited by 华尔街见闻, said the ECB governing council plans to discuss raising the minimum reserve ratio from 1% to 2% at its 25 November meeting, and that a decision could wait until 17 December.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻援引路透：欧洲央行管理委员会计划在11月25日的会议上讨论把最低准备金率从1%上调至2%，最终决定可能推迟到12月17日。

text.en: If December brings a 50 basis point increase, the dollar can stay supported even after the 10-year yield fell to 5.07%.
text.zh: 若12月加息50个基点，即使10年期收益率已经回落到5.07%，美元仍可能得到支撑。

text.en: If Anthropic's first session trades below the 83 dollar price, demand for AI shares looks weaker than the order book suggested.
text.zh: 若Anthropic首日交易跌破83美元的发行价，人工智能股票的需求就比订单簿显示的更弱。

text.en: If clashes widen and interrupt shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, crude could rise from the 83.26 dollar close.
text.zh: 若交火扩大并打断霍尔木兹海峡的出货，原油可能从83.26美元的收盘价回升。

globalTensions.en: Long-term Treasury yields fell while the minutes widened the hike consensus. Crude fell while clashes around the Gulf continued. The Nasdaq rose and the Dow fell. Gold fell to its lowest since September 2025.
globalTensions.zh: 纪要扩大了加息共识，长端国债收益率却回落了。海湾一带仍有交火，原油下跌。纳斯达克上涨，道指下跌。黄金跌至2025年9月以来最低。

chinaStance.en: Tencent's AI spending squeezed profit while revenue still grew. China and South Korea finished the second stage of their trade talks. 财经早茶 said foreign Treasury holdings posted their biggest drop in six months in September, and that China cut its own holdings.
chinaStance.zh: 腾讯的人工智能开支压住了利润，营收仍在增长。中韩完成自贸协定第二阶段谈判。财经早茶称，9月外国持有的美国国债创出六个月来最大降幅，中国也减持了自己的持仓。

text.en: Xi and Trump will hold their third in-person meeting of the year on Thursday. Xi said he looks forward to a deep exchange on bilateral relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the world order, and to moving a constructive and strategically stable relationship forward, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中美元首周四将举行年内第三次面对面会晤。习近平表示期待就中美关系、亚太合作及世界格局深入交换意见，并推动两国建设性战略稳定关系向前发展。

text.en: Xi shook hands and spoke briefly with Japanese prime minister Sanae Takaichi at the APEC welcome dinner. Japan's foreign ministry said the exchange was normal protocol, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：习近平在APEC欢迎宴会上与日本首相高市早苗握手并简短交谈。日本外务省称此次互动属正常礼宾安排。

text.en: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries posted their biggest drop in six months in September. China cut its holdings by nearly 27 billion dollars, and some analysts think Beijing may have traded some US securities through Canada and other countries, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：外国持有的美国国债9月创出六个月来最大降幅，中国减持了近270亿美元。一些分析人士认为，北京可能通过加拿大等其他国家交易了部分美国证券。

text.en: China and South Korea substantially completed the second stage of their free-trade talks. The two sides will open investment and services trade on a negative list, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国与韩国实质性完成自贸协定第二阶段谈判，双方将以负面清单模式推进投资和服务贸易开放。

text.en: Tencent's third-quarter revenue missed estimates, and operating profit fell for the first time in years. Capital spending jumped more than fourfold from a year earlier, and free cash flow was negative for a second quarter, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：腾讯第三季度营收低于预期，营业利润多年来首次下滑。资本支出同比激增逾四倍，自由现金流连续第二个季度为负。

text.en: Tencent president Liu said US limits on Chinese firms using advanced chips in overseas data centers will slow Chinese AI model development in the near term, and will push domestic chips faster over a longer period, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：腾讯总裁刘炽平表示，美国限制中国企业使用海外数据中心先进芯片，短期内将拖慢中国人工智能模型开发，长期来看会推动国产芯片加快发展。

text.en: The Information reported that ByteDance is in deep talks to buy about 500 million dollars more of Microsoft cloud services, mainly to use OpenAI models through Azure, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶援引The Information：字节跳动正就追加约5亿美元采购微软云服务进行深入谈判，主要用于通过微软Azure云使用OpenAI模型。

text.en: John Moolenaar, chair of the House select committee on China, said Microsoft should not sell AI tools to ByteDance, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国众议院中国特设委员会主席John Moolenaar表示，微软不应向字节跳动出售人工智能工具。

text.en: Reuters, citing people familiar with the matter, said the Trump administration is considering requiring US companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI models, to reduce reliance on that technology, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶援引路透：特朗普政府考虑要求美国企业披露使用中国人工智能模型的情况，以降低对相关技术的依赖。

text.en: Xi told an APEC business summit that China will cut tariffs and widen access, and he met President Putin the same day, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：习近平在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上表示中方将降低关税、扩大准入，并在当天会见普京。

text.en: The securities regulator denied a rumor that fund firms must report the AI exposure of every product, and a rumor platform denied a claim that someone at a State Council meeting said the state would stop frequent market rescues, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：证监会否认了基金公司须上报全部产品人工智能敞口的传闻，资本市场辟谣平台否认了国常会上有人表态不再频繁救市的说法。

text.en: Tencent's third-quarter revenue rose 8% and missed the estimate, non-IFRS operating profit fell 6%, and cloud revenue growth rose to 35%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：腾讯第三季度营收同比增长8%并低于预期，非国际财务报告准则经营盈利同比下降6%，云业务收入增速升至35%。

text.en: Xi met South Korean president Lee Jae-myung. Lee said South Korea's one-China policy has not changed and will not change, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：习近平会见韩国总统李在明。李在明称，韩方坚持一个中国政策，没有也不会改变。

text.en: JD's Hong Kong shares fell as much as 8.7% after the quarter missed estimates, and Morgan Stanley kept an underweight rating, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：京东港股盘中一度下跌8.7%，因季度业绩低于预期。摩根士丹利维持低配评级。

text.en: If the Shenzhen meetings take up chips, the Hopper shipment stop and the new loan clauses could be on the table.
text.zh: 若深圳的会晤谈芯片，停止出货Hopper和贷款文件里的新条款可能会被摆上桌面。

text.en: If US limits on overseas data-center chips stay in place, Tencent's capital spending can stay high while profit stays under pressure.
text.zh: 若美国对海外数据中心芯片的限制继续有效，腾讯的资本开支可能维持高位，利润继续承压。

chinaDivergences.en: Shanghai rose 0.09% while more than 4100 stocks fell and turnover was 1.37 trillion yuan, a low for the year. Long-term Treasury yields fell while the minutes widened the hike consensus. Crude fell while clashes around the Gulf continued.
chinaDivergences.zh: 上证上涨0.09%，逾4100只个股下跌，成交1.37万亿元，创年内新低。纪要扩大了加息共识，长端国债收益率却回落了。海湾一带仍有交火，原油下跌。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 19 November, through next Friday, 27 November. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy decision falls in these dates. The October minutes were released at 03:00 Beijing on 19 November and are already in the text. After the November switch to standard time, a decision at 14:00 US Eastern is 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月19日到下周五11月27日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息决定。10月会议纪要已于11月19日北京时间03:00发布，写在正文里。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。

Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。
